title: A Mars Mission Could Cost 30% Of Hip Bone Density
hook: Mars sounds thrilling until 30% of hip bone density disappears.
closing: Reaching Mars matters only if astronauts return with bodies strong enough to live.
question: Would this change your Mars plans?

segments.say: Astronaut bone density can fall 1.5% monthly. Without gravity's loading, the skeleton starts shedding strength.
Astronaut hip density can drop 2.2% monthly. Weight-bearing bone takes the hardest hit.
A Mars mission could cost 30% of hip bone density without protection. Countermeasures become part of survival.
